text: Hey boss. What can I do for you?
You need to go to heartbeat.
You mean telling them that I'm even more of an embarrassment than he says I am?

They're not an embarrassment. You may need a Harvey to put the ball on the end zone, but you have the idea. You set it up, and you drove the ball down to the one guideline. No. I didn't have the idea. You had the idea. And you executed it. But you're giving me credit. If Harvey executes this, he'll give you credit. Well, he never does. Of course, he might. You want him to see a different side of you. Give him a chance to show a different side of him. You know what? It doesn't matter anyway. Harvey doesn't need my help anymore. It's too late. No. It isn't. Haven't you heard?
Have you seen bad news? What is it?
I think you should sit down.
not unless someone died. I don't need to sit down. Just tell me. Pressing to know just fired us.

You don't know that. One plus one equals two Ghana, and I know how to goddamn add. I didn't count the Folsom money, and suddenly our oil revenues are gone, and her piece of the pie just skyrocketed. Harvey, please don't do anything much. What the hell are you saying? I'm saying call her. How would that go? Hey, Scotty. Thanks for taking me over. Could you please take it back? You don't know how it would go, and you could find out if you would drop your pride and just give her the benefit of a doubt. You gave someone the benefit of the doubt. Look how that turned out.
I think just because you bought me a handbag, you can say that to me.
Okay, sleeping. Wake me when you need something.
